summary: Mille Lacs County: a July 1965 St. Cloud Times notice of a planned 100-ft Milaca tower; FFLA lists the site gone. The Kathio tower is a separate, moved structure.

events.note: Newspaper notice, quoted by Central US Lookouts, says a 100-foot tower will be erected, to be called the Milaca tower; a plan, not a confirmed build

notes_for_editor: Only one line of history exists: a 1965 notice of a planned tower, quoted on the Central US site. The height_m of 30.5 is the planned 100 feet from that notice, not a confirmed build height. The FFLA gone entry matches the brief's coordinates. The FFLA also lists a separate '(Wahkon) Mille Lacs' tower at 46.09714, -93.49071, marked gone; it is not this record and is not used. The Kathio tower is a different, moved structure and is not used as this site's history. Two searches found no record that the Milaca tower was completed, who ran it, or when it came down. The 7-mile-south, 2-mile-east position is roughly consistent with the brief's coordinates by my own arithmetic; that is not cited.
